claims.summary: A fresh deployed v0.15.36 Genetics and Society audit showed the source-ledger bridge worked: the package exported five source rows and local regrade removed the previous source-thinness P1.

claims.summary: The same audit exposed generic Crossref metadata hits for building-environment and geotechnical-testing standards attaching to genetics lessons by broad word overlap only.
Source-finder now requires academic metadata rows for genetics contexts to carry a genetics/genomics anchor in the source itself before they can attach.
A focused regression rejects generic environment/testing Crossref traps while preserving genetics-specific Crossref rows for gene-environment interaction and genetic testing topics.

carryForward.next: Build a real ResearchSession planner that researches course concepts once, caches a trusted ledger, maps retrieved source rows to CurriculumV1 atoms, and compiles many deliverables without browsing per artifact.
Prefer license-safe OER/official/academic rows over metadata-only Crossref/OpenLibrary rows when multiple relevant choices exist.
Check whether each atom's sourceRefs are topically relevant to that atom rather than only structurally present.
